method: Independent source-only review of EXT-F-1003-T51, the isolated admin reset runner and its native side-panel harness, Settings reset/sign-out implementation, and sanitized runner report. No test, build, install, process, or browser was launched.

verdict_a_acceptance.source_assessment: The runner follows the required real UI sequence: real web login, extension Settings sign-in, Cancel, Confirm, and native panel reload. It checks signed-in admin controls, Dark preference, auth-key presence, a disposable session fixture, and local/session key removal after Confirm.
verdict_a_acceptance.runtime_status: UNVERIFIED; no native Chrome interaction was performed in this review.
verdict_a_acceptance.risk_or_gap: After reload, the runner checks only known auth/settings/session sentinels. It does not compare all pre-reset local and session key names against the reloaded storage, so a non-sentinel extension key restored during boot could escape detection.
verdict_a_acceptance.side_effect_scope: The harness owns a fresh temporary Chrome profile, verifies its DevTools endpoint and spawned-process ownership, and deletes only that profile. The real admin login/reset also creates and revokes the disposable profile's auth session; signOut makes a best-effort Supabase logout request. No application/account data mutation is present in the runner, but describing the flow as having no server-side effect at all would be inaccurate.

passing_source_evidence: No primary Chrome profile is attached: the harness launches Chrome with a newly created temporary user-data directory and rejects an endpoint/profile not owned by its child.
The runner performs UI clicks on the actual SIDE_PANEL, rather than directly invoking reset implementation code.

Credential reads are confined to the authorized aidream .env and actual login form. Catch paths emit fixed stage/category labels; storage inspection exports auth-key booleans and key names, never auth values. The session fixture value is used only for equality checks and is not serialized.
The report writes an allowlisted evidence object with mode 0600. The harness screenshot capture occurs before admin login, while the panel is still a guest.
The reset implementation clears extension local/session storage and invokes signOut. SignOut clears local auth state and may send a best-effort scope=local logout request for this disposable session.

findings.issue: The reload oracle checks only the named auth/settings/session sentinels. It omits comparison of every pre-reset local/session key against reloaded storage. A key that is restored during extension boot after the immediate post-confirm sample would not fail acceptance.
findings.repair: Retain the pre-reset key-name snapshots in process memory and assert that their intersection with localKeys and sessionKeys remains empty after panel reload. Do not serialize storage values or the fixture value.

verdict_b_engineering_quality.verification_limit: Source inspection only. No syntax check, test, build, browser run, or mutation proof was performed.
